watches.name: AQUA GREEN
watches.description: Introducing the new limited edition Diver 40 Aqua Green - a modern interpretation of a vintage diver’s watch. Limited to 200 pieces (individually numbered). The Aqua Green is housed in a finely brushed 316L stainless steel case with polished accents. The case measures 40mm, and a slightly domed sapphire crystal protects the dial and movement. The watch is powered by an automatic movement (caliber NH35) with over 40-hours of power reserve. The dial takes inspiration from vintage diver’s watches, featuring applied markers with Super-LumiNova luminescence (BGW9), which, in combination with plated hands with luminescent inlays, ensures high legibility in the dark. The teal dial follows the same concept as the Aqua Blue, is created to mimic the view of the surface when ascending from a dive, with a gradient sunburst finish in blue that transitions from dark to light, capturing the reflection of light as it hits the water during ascent. The Diver 40 is water-resistant up to 20 ATM, equivalent to 200 meters (660 ft) of atmospheric pressure, and together with the unidirectional rotating bezel, makes it highly suitable for dives. It is also fitted with our new integrated FKM rubber strap, which offers both comfort and durability. The materials and components used to create this watch are straightforward: 316L stainless steel, scratch-proof sapphire crystal, automatic movement, and FKM rubber—all selected for their functionality and style. If you have any questions, please Contact Us.
